# Golden captures.
#
# file<TAB>surface<TAB>captured<TAB>url<TAB>why
#
# Every file in this directory must have a line here and every line must have a
# file, and TestCaptureLedger fails on either mismatch. A capture with no line
# is a page nobody can say the provenance of, which is the same as no capture.
#
# All captures fetched with the tool's own User-Agent at the 2 second default
# pace. Stored gzipped, since a book page is a megabyte and the repo should not
# carry fifteen of them.

book_show_2767052.html.gz	s1	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2767052	popular book, dense cache, 129 entities, full stats and distribution
book_show_1885.html.gz	s1	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/1885	second book page, a different cache shape to check the extractor is not fitted to one page
author_show_1077326.html.gz	s2	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/1077326	prolific author, and a Rails page rather than a Next.js one
work_editions_2792775.html.gz	s6	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/work/editions/2792775	the first robots.txt exception path
work_quotes_2792775.html.gz	s7	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/work/quotes/2792775	the second exception path
list_show_1.html.gz	s4	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/list/show/1	Listopia, ranked books
genres_fantasy.html.gz	s5	2026-08-15	https://www.goodreads.com/genres/fantasy	genre page, featured books and related genres
book_reviews_2767052.js.gz	s12	2026-08-16	https://www.goodreads.com/book/reviews/2767052	the paginated review set, and the one surface that answers with JavaScript rather than HTML
series_45175.html.gz	s3	2026-08-16	https://www.goodreads.com/series/45175-harry-potter	the one Rails surface that carries its own JSON, in data-react-props rather than __NEXT_DATA__
book_auto_complete_hunger_games.json.gz	s14	2026-08-16	https://www.goodreads.com/book/auto_complete?format=json&q=hunger+games	the allowed search route, and the only surface that hands over a book id and its work id in one response
search_books_hunger_games.html.gz	s10	2026-08-16	https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=the+hunger+games&search_type=books	the search page, disallowed, level 3 only, and the richest single page of book rows on the site
search_people_hunger_games.html.gz	s10	2026-08-16	https://www.goodreads.com/search?q=the+hunger+games&search_type=people	the people tab, which answers 200 with zero rows when signed out, and is the proof that it does
